title: Mixed Event — Carnation Recollection — Episode7 Beyond the Labyrinth

meta.Event Outline: Despite Kanade's persistent efforts to save Mafuyu, none of the songs she composes seem to leave an impression on her. Feeling like she's reached a dead end, Kanade heads to SEKAI for advice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mizuki helped remind me about a lot of things today.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm still not sure what kind of song will save Mafuyu, but that's okay...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I just have to keep trying.
No matter how long it takes.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It feels like I've taken a step closer, but some things are still missing...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It needs to be softer and gentler...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's so gentle and warm, like I'm being wrapped in a blanket. Dad's songs have these qualities.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But what am I missing? How did dad capture these feelings so well...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (When he made this song, he was...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: As long as my music makes you and your mother smile, I'll be more than happy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: As long as it made us smile even a little bit...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Dad sang that song because he wanted mom and me to smile...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(So what's my goal?
What do I want for Mafuyu?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I... I just don't want her to disappear...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (No, that's just a personal desire. I want her to stay so that I don't get hurt...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (What do I want her to feel? What do I want her to do?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want her to be her the way she wants to be... I think...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I don't know who that Mafuyu is. What's going to happen when she does find the “real” her?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I really wasn't thinking about Mafuyu's best interests, was I...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll be stuck in a loop at this rate...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What is it that you want people to see or realize by hearing this?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What do I want people to realize...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What do I want Mafuyu to realize...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Your father's music always finds a way to make me smile.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm not sure I can put it into words but...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want her to be able to feel a lot of different emotions like mom did back then...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This seems completely different from anything I made before...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (What kind of expression will Mafuyu have on her face after listening to this?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want all of them to listen to it.
